messages:
emily: Tiny UX bug: paste a param like {"name":"email"} into the schema editor -> save -> banner says "Schema invalid" but no indication which param.

sam: Ugh. We should surface an inline marker and let users jump to it. Pasting is common.

emily: Repro steps: new fn -> add param -> paste snippet missing "type" -> save -> banner. No inline caret.

kai: We validate on save for perf reasons and show a top banner on failures.

emily: Can we run a cheap debounced lint on the edited subtree and show an inline icon + tooltip? Keep banner for fatal errors.

aisha: A11y: banner alone isn't enough. Need role=alert announcement with node path and a focusable "Jump to error" link. Say: "Schema error in parameter 'email': missing type. Press Enter to jump."

sam: Tooltip copy idea: "Missing required field: "type". Press Enter or click to focus this parameter."

kai: Dev plan: 600ms debounce, validate edited node only, render inline button with aria-label and tabindex, keep banner for save-level failures.

emily: Also soften banner copy to: "Schema validation failed \u2014 see inline markers for details."

sam: Related: run history currently shows raw payload blobs. Proposal: show a compact preview row (first 2-3 keys + types) with a keyboard-focusable expand button that lazy-loads the full tree. Use aria-expanded and aria-controls.

aisha: Keyboard flow: expand should move focus into tree, support arrow nav, and announce expansion politely. Ensure contrast and 44px touch targets for inline icons.

design-bot: Created tickets: "schema: inline lint + accessible jump", "run-history: structured preview + keyboard", "copy: schema banner". Assigning @sam and @kai.

emily: Can someone post a tiny mock of the inline tooltip + run-history preview before next design review?

sam: On it 1 tomorrow in #design-review.
